opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March for a decision in May
15 September for a decision in November
15 December for a decision in March

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects.
opportunities.summary: Our small grants are awarded as ‘seed funding’ with the aim of enabling projects that might otherwise not be possible without our support. Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health

deadlines.raw: 1 December for a decision in March of the following year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study.
opportunities.summary: Butterfield Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. They are intended to be broad in application and can also support the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
